C1372.title: Shandong Qingdao Mnemonic Memory Theft Case: 107 BTC Stolen
C1372.summary: The defendant Zhang exploited the opportunity of assisting Feng with a digital wallet transaction. While Feng wrote down the 12-word mnemonic phrase, Zhang secretly memorized 11 complete words and the first letter of the remaining word. He later brute-forced the missing part, gained control of the wallet, and transferred 107 BTC, cashing out over 660,000 RMB through an exchange platform. The court
